scope: Deduplicated WebP photos under assets/images, with use and displayed photo-credit metadata scanned from English country index pages. Complete source/creator/license fields are distinct from independent rights verification: independent source-page checks and unverified claims are counted from the current asset records; every checked source is listed with its date and finding. The separate build image tally also includes favicon.svg.

verificationMethod.structuredRecords: Imported every data/*.mjs module and merged objects with a local /assets/images/*.webp source path.
verificationMethod.visibleCredits: Parsed photo-credit list items in English page sections with class sources. For images without structured records, unambiguous same-page or globally unique label/alt matches were accepted; eight explicit source-caption matches are documented by asset path and note.
verificationMethod.sourcePageChecks: Manually checked source pages marked source_page_checked on 2026-10-04, 2026-10-05, or 2026-10-06, with the check date and finding on each row. Other source/license declarations are transcribed from local metadata or visible site credits and have not been independently checked during this inventory.
verificationMethod.imageDeduplication: Grouped image files by SHA-256 bytes; the listed paths remain attached to their group.
verificationMethod.buildImageCountReconciliation: The 779 WebP photos in assets/images plus favicon.svg (an SVG icon counted by build-dist.mjs) explain the previous build tally of 780 images.

knownHistoricalMismatch.previousIssue: The prior image showed Piazza Navona while labeling the Trastevere route.
knownHistoricalMismatch.correction: Replaced with a visually checked photograph of the fountain in Piazza Santa Maria in Trastevere.
knownHistoricalMismatch.currentFile: The current replacement remains included as the current asset at the same path.
